title: One Prompt Became a Playable 3D Shooter
script: One prompt. Eight hours. A playable 3D shooter. No game studio. No asset team. An Anthropic engineer ran Claude Fable 5.2 with no human feedback during the build. The result is Saltline, a browser FPS in a rainy industrial harbor. Here’s the crazy part. The whole game is one HTML file. About 1.4 megabytes. No image files. No audio files. No 3D models. Code generates the geometry, textures, and sound. The run reportedly cost around five hundred fifty dollars in API compute. Is it AAA? No. Is it a glimpse of what AI building looks like? Absolutely.
cta: Follow AI Tested for more AI builds that shouldn’t be possible.
concept: Build-log reveal: code/file-size shock, no-assets reveal, generated systems breakdown, cost reveal, wild-but-limited payoff.
